clips.title: The story
paras: At the Scarlet Raven in Darkshire, Tavernkeep Smitts hears the town’s gossip and its unsolved tragedies. His long memory and keen eye make him a valuable contact for anyone seeking the region’s dark history.

Tavernkeep Smitts keeps the Scarlet Raven’s hearth fires warm and serves drink to weary travelers, townspeople, and nervous Night Watch guards facing Duskwood’s perils. He has been one of Darkshire’s familiar public faces for years, and rumors pass through his tavern every day. While other townsfolk hide behind locked shutters, Smitts watches those who enter and leave. He notices strange patrons, hurried departures, and behavior that does not fit the town.
